rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for a book or pad with blank pages used for sketching.

example.english: I always carry a sketchbook and draw street scenes when I have time.
example.traditional: 我成日帶住本畫簿，得閒就畫吓街景。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 daai3 zyu6 bun2 waak6 bou2 dak1 haan4 zau6 waa2 haa5 gaai1 ging2

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that the book is specifically for formal or artistic sketching rather than general drawing.

example.english: The teacher told me to bring a sketchbook to the studio to prepare to draw a plaster statue.
example.traditional: 老師叫我帶本素描簿返畫室，準備畫石膏像。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 giu3 ngo5 daai2 bun2 sou3 miu4 bou2 faan2 waa2 sat1 zeon2 bei6 waak6 sek6 gou1 zoeng6
